sn55.40:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
sn55.40:1.2: atha kho nandiyo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho nandiyo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn55.40:1.3: yasseva nu kho bhante ariyasāvakassa cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ natthi sveva nu kho bhante ariyasāvako pamādavihārīti vuccati.
sn55.40:2.1: yassa kho nandiya cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ natthi tamahaṃ bāhiro puthujjanapakkhe ṭhitoti vadāmi.
sn55.40:2.2: apica nandiya yathā ariyasāvako pamādavihārī ceva hoti appamādavihārī ca
sn55.40:2.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho nandiyo sakko bhagavato paccassosi.
sn55.40:3.2: idha nandiya ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti
sn55.40:3.3: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.40:3.4: so tena buddhe aveccappasādena santuṭṭho na uttariṃ vāyamati divā pavivekāya rattiyā paṭisallānāya.
sn55.40:3.5: tassa evaṃ pamattassa viharato pāmujjaṃ na hoti
sn55.40:4.3: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akkhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.40:4.4: so tehi ariyakantehi sīlehi santuṭṭho na uttariṃ vāyamati divā pavivekāya rattiyā paṭisallāṇāya.
sn55.40:4.5: tassa evaṃ pamattassa viharato pāmujjaṃ na hoti
sn55.40:4.12: evaṃ kho nandiya ariyasāvako pamādavihārī hoti.
